description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by adopt-0006. End of the P0 promise: on a bare folder with no config and no index, init synthesizes agsc.config.json and content/index.md whose every value is schema-valid — site.base is the http://localhost/ development placeholder that AGSC-01-19 and config.schema.json admit, build.out is www/, the index title passes the 3-120 bound and its description the 40-200 bound — so the very next command, ci, exits 0 offline. Findings are warnings only, including AGSC-E506 telling the owner to set a real site.base before publishing. If this vector exits non-zero the three-command promise of PRD-053 is broken at step two.

reason: Withdrawn at rc.6 (2026-09-25) and superseded by adopt-0006. AGSC-02-94(a) as amended 2026-09-25 says that init writes site.tdm_crawlers[] with its starting crawler list when the synthesized configuration adopts the Content Use Terms, because a reservation naming no crawler fails the build (AGSC-06-18); this case's expected configuration carried no crawler list, so it no longer described what init writes. adopt-0006 is the same case with the list.
